desc:
Each round one player becomes the first zombie. Zombies infect, humans survive until the timer ends. Some rounds turn into Nemesis, Survivor, Swarm, Plague, Assassin or Sniper.

Pick a zombie or human class, each with its own skill. Deal damage to earn ammo packs, then buy grenades, night vision, armor or a jetpack with a bazooka.

NEW: Base Builder! Humans build a base from the map's blocks while the zombies wait, then hold out until time is up. Also: Fun Modes (CT vs T on classic maps), Zombie Escape and Boss Arena with 6 bosses every 30 minutes.

Clans get 3 weekly and 3 daily goals for ammo packs. Join the Tenshi-Studio group for 25% faster ammo packs (Premium also gets 25%, both get 50%). Free ammo packs every day, plus 1 extra each round with a friend in the server.

PC: WASD, mouse, M menu, O settings, E class skill. Phone and controller supported.

If you enjoy the game, please give the game a like 👍
